notes.title: You can now add props to your avatar!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33585007/4ecb9c865d1574c051951edbdacb5078056e9040.jpg[/img]

We added some fun new features to the Studio Broadcast avatars - props!

So far you can add up to five props to your avatar at one time.  The arrangement of the props you wear will be saved so they're all still in place the next time you come through.

Currently, you can choose from a bow tie, a mustache, cat ears, sunglasses, and a rainbow hair poof, with new props coming soon (keep an eye out for a monocle, tophat, and microphone). 

Prop requests are welcome! And if you're Blender savvy, you can submit your own, also - they just need to be <400 vertices and created using vertex painting.

notes.title: Recent Updates
notes.notes:
It's been a while since we've posted any updates so here are some recent developments in GonzoVR:

[list]
[*] There are avatars in the studio broadcasts now! There are two speaker slots where you can step up and engage in discussion as a cute little avatar. There's also a spot where only you can see your avatar so you can have fun and play around with it if you're not ready to join the conversation.
[*] We've improved the quality of the stream significantly with some excellent denoising solutions.
[*] We've made discussions easier to follow by decreasing the volume of viewer's voices unless they're in a speaker slot where they can be heard at a normal volume. This helps prevent people from speaking over each other and also gives some visual representation of the people talking.
[/list]

Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/PVg72w]discord[/url] to stay updated and catch the studio broadcast every night at 6 pm PST!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1/2/19
notes.notes:
Latest patch going up now:
1) You can now watch past broadcasts. Currently we have the Rob from Cyanide and Happiness, Abe Groening, and the cooking broadcast we did
2) Minor optimizations to the audio decoder
3) Better handling of the microphone, so hopefully the rare issue where your mic remains unconnected will be fixed
4) People with lower end GPUs and people on high pings get a smaller resolution pano which means higher frame rate and faster room joins

Also, the past broadcasts had some issues with the compression, so they don't look as crisp or as bright as they ought to. Not certain if we'll fix this right now

notes.title: Recent Patch Updates 12/13/18
notes.notes:
Here is a rundown of some recent patches:

-Minor optimizations to the audio encoder
-- Receives messages from the broadcaster app
-- Fixes with typing long messages and their display
-- Fixed rare null reference
-Fixed the rare issue where sometimes one eye would be black and rotated
-Lobby images and some marker images are now cached to your local hard drive, so they will load much faster.
-The desktop streaming marker will show the GVR logo if no one is currently streaming, and I put in a fairly sizeable performance improvement regarding CPU usage

This Sunday (November 18) instead of the regular guest broadcast, we'll start a broadcast a little earlier in the day (probably 4 pm PST or so) where you can come and hang out with Ela and her friends while we play d&d! The group is known asI Hit it with My Axe.

You can look forward to meeting: Zak Smith (creator of Demon City, illustrator of the Gravity's Rainbow graphic novel), Sara Pocock (an animator who has worked on Community, and Cosmos), Morgana Altre (a character actor who has been in Stan Against Evil and played Edgar in The Curious Creations of Christine McConnell), and Adam Moore, an actor, writer, and gamer in LA. notes.title: First Patches are Out
notes.notes:
We just pushed our first two patches:
1) After loading broadcasts, you're immediately shown the live broadcasts. A lot of people seem to have dropped out before actually trying anything
2) The exit key is now a bit yellow, hopefully this will bring a bit more attention to it. It seems that no one actually knew how to leave a broadcast. We'll probably also change the icon or text for it
3) You get a notification in the chat if your mic is on
4) Hopefully-maybe-possibly fixed the audio bug some people experienced: where they couldn't hear some other users but other users could hear them.
